native_rewrite.english_gloss: Question: 'Merzļikins has already saved 31 shots after two periods. How do you rate his game?' Options: 'Legendary' / 'Excellent' / 'Solid' / 'He's getting lucky'. Reveal: 'Thanks to Merzļikins' 31 saves, Latvia leads Canada 2:1 before the third period.'

buff.title: Merzļikins tur cietoksni!
buff.question: Merzļikins atvairījis jau 31 metienu. Vai Latvija noturēs pārsvaru arī trešajā trešdaļā?
buff.reveal: Pēc divām trešdaļām Latvija vada ar 2:1 pār Kanādu!
buff.english_gloss: Title: Merzļikins holds the fortress! Question: Merzļikins has already turned away 31 shots. Will Latvia hold the lead in the third period too? Options: Definitely will hold! / Canada will equalize / There will be overtime / Latvia will score again. Reveal: After two periods Latvia leads Canada 2:1!

issues: [error] term.calque: 'trešdaļa' used; prefer 'periods' for 'period (ice hockey)'

errors.explanation: A hockey period is 'periods', not the calque 'trešdaļa' ('third'). The glossary explicitly bans 'trešdaļa', and it reads as translated.
The same banned term for period appears in the reveal.
'pār Kanādu' calques English 'over Canada'. Latvian press says 'vada pret Kanādu ar 2:1'.

errors.span: Vai Latvija noturēs pārsvaru arī trešajā trešdaļā?
errors.explanation: A yes/no question does not match the multi-outcome options ('Būs papildlaiks', 'Latvija vēl iemetīs'). An open question fits the options better.
The bare 'iemetīs' without an object or with this word order sounds clipped. 'Iemetīs vēl' reads more naturally.

native_rewrite.title: Merzļikins tur cietoksni!
native_rewrite.question: Merzļikins atvairījis jau 31 metienu. Kā beigsies trešais periods?
native_rewrite.reveal: Pēc diviem periodiem Latvija vada pret Kanādu ar 2:1!
native_rewrite.english_gloss: Merzļikins has already saved 31 shots. How will the third period end? Options: Latvia will hold on to 2:1 / Canada will equalize / There will be overtime / Latvia will score more. Reveal: After two periods Latvia leads Canada 2:1!

buff.title: Merzļikins seisab kindlalt
buff.question: Merzļikinsil on kahe perioodiga 31 tõrjet. Mis on Läti 2-1 eduseisu võti?
buff.reveal: Läti, 2023. aasta pronksimedalist, juhib 40 minuti järel MM-ide edukaima riigi vastu.
buff.english_gloss: Title: Merzļikins Standing Tall. Question: Merzļikins has 31 saves through two periods. What's been the key to Latvia's 2-1 lead? Options: Merzļikins' saves / Clinical finishing / Team defense / Crowd energy. Reveal: Latvia, 2023 bronze medalists, lead the most decorated World Championship nation after 40 minutes.

errors.explanation: House style writes scores with a colon, not a hyphen.
This is a slight calque of 'crowd energy'. Estonian sports copy more often says „publiku toetus“.
It is understandable but a bit flat. „Kaitsemäng“ is the usual sports term for team defence.
It is slightly stiff, and in sport the side is usually called „koondis“ rather than „riik“. Naming Canada would also read more naturally.
errors.suggested_fix: MM-ide ajaloo edukaima koondise Kanada vastu

buff.title: Kas Läti peab vastu?
buff.question: Merzļikins on teinud juba 31 tõrjet, Läti juhib 2:1. Mis otsustab kolmanda kolmandiku?
buff.reveal: Läti võitis 2023. aastal oma esimese MM-medali – pronksi.
buff.english_gloss: Title: Will Latvia hold on? Question: Merzļikins has already made 31 saves, Latvia leads 2-1. What will decide the third period? Options: Merzļikins's saves / Latvia's defence / Canada's pressure / Latvia's counterattacks. Reveal: Latvia won its first World Championship medal, bronze, in 2023.

issues: [error] term.calque: 'kolmandik' used; prefer 'periood' for 'period (ice hockey)'

errors.explanation: In Estonian hockey coverage a period is 'periood'; 'kolmandik' is a rare calque. 'Kolmanda kolmandiku' also sounds clumsy.
'Otsustama perioodi' (to decide the period) is odd. The stakes are the match, so the question should be about deciding the game.
'Tõrjet tegema' calques 'make saves'. Broadcasters usually use the verb: 'tõrjus/on tõrjunud 31 pealeviset'.
'Kontrad' is colloquial; 'vasturünnakud' is the standard term on ERR and in sports copy.

native_rewrite.reveal: Läti võitis 2023. aastal oma esimese MM-medali – pronksi.
